description: This file defines an interface 'ExternalOAuthProviderConnectorInterface' in PHP that specifies methods for integrating external OAuth providers within the SuiteCRM project. It includes method signatures related to OAuth provider details, token handling, configuration, and URL generation.

methods.name: getProviderID
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the OAuth provider.

methods.name: getProviderType
methods.description: Returns the type of the OAuth provider.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURL
methods.description: Generates the authorization URL for OAuth flow, given client ID and secret.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Obtains an access token using the authorization code.

methods.name: refreshAccessToken
methods.description: Refreshes the access token using a refresh token.

methods.name: mapAccessToken
methods.description: Maps the token object to an internal array format.

methods.name: getClientID
methods.description: Determines the client ID to use based on request and provider config.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Determines the client secret to use based on request and provider config.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Constructs the redirect URI for OAuth callback.

methods.name: getAuthorizeURLOptions
methods.description: Provides options for constructing the authorization URL.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestOptions
methods.description: Provides options for requesting an access token.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequestGrant
methods.description: Specifies the grant type used in token requests.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns an OAuth provider instance based on client credentials.
